reason: My doctor said my magnesium could be low, and this is the first one that names the lab and puts the batch report on the page, which is what I check before buying. At $24.99 for the first box I'd try one, but not two.
objection: $29.99 is more than Toplux or Goli and I don't know if the report is real until I open it and see the lab name and a batch number that matches the box. Reviews are missing too.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report on the page turned out to be generic or not for the batch, or the dose on the label didn't match the report, I'd pass.
